findings.description: Complete the required suspect-pair reconciliation or obtain approval to defer it. Issue #2808 requires: "Check whether each pair is one pub, and add the address if it is two." The added merge list resolves other pairs but leaves Crown (venue-d81nvz, venue-7dqmn6) and Angel (venue-16ga1jj, venue-1cbx68v) separate, with only "Hillingdon, Greater London" in public/data/pint_prices_app_dataset.json:1. The captain's later #2808 comment also requires real addresses for Duke of York (venue-1dzgxpa, venue-1ux9oxk), which still say only "Hounslow". These unresolved identities also remain in public/data/venues_slim.json:1, without reconciliation entries in public/data/venue_id_aliases.json:6. Millers Well (venue-10paqy, venue-1i5w333) and Duck & Waffle (food-duck-waffle, restaurant-duck-and-waffle) also remain separate without a current recorded disposition. The old Millers hold at scripts/lib/venueCanonicalization.mjs:263 predates this task. Verify these cases and repair confirmed duplicates or required addresses through their existing source pipeline. Do not merge unverified suspects automatically. Any narrower scope needs the captain's decision. Later requirement: https://github.com/Singularityszn/pubmax/issues/2808#issuecomment-6800215841.

Remove or semantically refine the in-scope text-only assertions, as the review's test-quality rule requires. __tests__/mapOpeningPreview.test.ts:157-161 checks a loader source expression, and :312-324 checks canvas source tokens instead of executing either behaviour. Dead or disconnected code can satisfy these checks. Also, __tests__/priceHistory.test.ts:589 and :605 search raw JSON text for historical source URLs. Valid JSON escaping can hide the same URL from these assertions while its consumer still reads it. Exercise the loader or map lifecycle for the first class. Parse the published price artifacts and compare their consumed provenance URLs against the historical-source set for the second. The independent outcomes are a usable eager-cell load, readiness belonging to the current map, and historical evidence excluded from current-price records.

testing_summary: No tests ran, as required for the review phase. Reviewed the history and all 1,544 changed paths between e8c519d8451680a7d78196c84464534da39b2352 and 9baf7e71d0e4d6a5df002262c07fc742435a987b. Read-only semantic analysis covered all changed JSON blobs, both 622-file UK base generations, every changed slim shard, manifests, the canonical dataset, aliases, price bundle, history, historic joins, menu overlay, FHRS links and discovery output. The 4,071 price rows retain every non-identity field. The London index loses exactly the twelve aliased identities. Slim shards retain the correct manifest counts and full-index projections. UK base generation retains all 45,567 pub records, with the Rose & Crown owner resolved to its canonical id. The removed Eastbrook history observation remains under its canonical id. Reviewed every changed test and source file, and traced alias reads through browser/server resolution and account-scoped operator lookups. No additional unnecessary component or concrete authorization/privacy defect was substantiated. Existing review-result.json and .review-r1-* files concern different commits and were not accepted as evidence for this head.
